description: Exchange a Text-Em-All account username + PIN/password for that user's authorization token (the value you set as TEXTEMALL_AUTH_TOKEN). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/user/login. Signed with your App/Secret key only (no user token yet). Returns { AuthToken }. Use this once to bootstrap; store the token in config thereafter.

password.description: The Text-Em-All website login PIN/password. Required.

username.description: The Text-Em-All website login username. Required.

name: get_authorization_token
title: Get a user authorization token
